entities.name: UniProt Q0SIG6 TatA
observations: The 91-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed Rhodococcus jostii TatA Q0SIG6 (100% identity and coverage; E=5.85e-58).
TatA is a membrane component of the twin-arginine translocation system; UniProt annotation says it may form the protein-conducting channel for folded proteins with twin-arginine signal peptides.
Sequence scanning detected TatA_B_E domain PF02416.22 at residues 4–49.
Sequence-derived properties: 91 aa; calculated molecular mass 9,653 Da; theoretical pI 8.18.
